## Premise correction

**Redis is not used or configured anywhere in this repo.** A full-text search returns **0 matches** for `redis`, and `go.mod`/`go.sum` contain no Redis client dependencies. There is no Redis connection string, env var, or external cache backend.

The cache layer is a **process-local, in-memory cache** (`sync.Map` + TTL), implemented in `store/cache/cache.go` and wired up in `store/store.go`.

### Where it is configured

Cache settings are hardcoded when `Store` is constructed — not loaded from Redis or external config:

```39:53:/bench/repo/store/store.go
	// Default cache settings
	cacheConfig := cache.Config{
		DefaultTTL:      10 * time.Minute,
		CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute,
		MaxItems:        1000,
		OnEviction:      nil,
	}

	store := &Store{
		// ...
		instanceSettingCache: cache.New(cacheConfig),
		userCache:            cache.New(cacheConfig),
		userSettingCache:     cache.New(cacheConfig),
```

The same defaults are defined in `store/cache/cache.go`:

```56:64:/bench/repo/store/cache/cache.go
func DefaultConfig() Config {
	return Config{
		DefaultTTL:      10 * time.Minute,
		CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute,
		MaxItems:        1000,
		OnEviction:      nil,
	}
}
```

`cache.New()` starts an in-process cleanup goroutine; no network connection is involved:

```75:85:/bench/repo/store/cache/cache.go
func New(config Config) *Cache {
	c := &Cache{
		config:     config,
		stopChan:   make(chan struct{}),
		closedChan: make(chan struct{}),
	}

	go c.cleanupLoop()
	return c
}
```

### User-entry TTL

User entries use the **default TTL: 10 minutes**.

Evidence:
- All user writes call `userCache.Set(...)` (not `SetWithTTL`), e.g. in `store/user.go` lines 98, 122, 132, 143, 167.
- `Set` delegates to `SetWithTTL` with `c.config.DefaultTTL`:

```92:95:/bench/repo/store/cache/cache.go
func (c *Cache) Set(ctx context.Context, key string, value any) {
	c.SetWithTTL(ctx, key, value, c.config.DefaultTTL)
}
```

- Expiry is enforced on `Get` (lazy) and by a background cleanup every **5 minutes** (`CleanupInterval`).

### Related (not Redis) caches

| Location | Type | TTL |
|---|---|---|
| `store/store.go` | In-memory `userCache`, `userSettingCache`, `instanceSettingCache` | 10 min default |
| `server/router/rss/rss.go` | In-memory RSS feed map | 1 hour (`defaultCacheDuration`) |
| `web/src/components/MemoEditor/services/cacheService.ts` | Browser/local editor draft cache | Separate frontend concern |

**Bottom line:** The premise that Redis backs the cache layer is **false**. User cache TTL is **10 minutes**, configured in `store/store.go:40–41` and applied via `store/cache/cache.go:92–94`.
